title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-08
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 40 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Claude Code lead Boris Cherny shared his actual prompts and said he was surprised people were surprised: talk to Claude like a coworker. There's no secret to prompting, and most tasks don't need heavy scaffolding or prescriptive instructions — give Claude a goal and it will figure it out. Back in the Sonnet 3.5 days the prompt mattered a lot; now what matters is communicating (1) what you want it to do, (2) how much effort to spend, and (3) how it should verify it did the right thing.
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 公开了自己真实使用的 prompt，并表示惊讶于大家会对此感到意外：跟 Claude 说话就像跟同事说话一样，提示词没有秘诀，大多数任务不需要过度搭脚手架或写得过于规定化——给 Claude 一个目标，它会自己想办法。他指出 Sonnet 3.5 时代 prompt 写法影响很大，但如今更重要的是跟模型讲清三件事：要它做什么、希望它投入多少精力、它该如何验证自己做对了。

featured.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
featured.summaryEn: Thariq from the Claude Code team described the direction: increasingly Claude's "brains" will live in the cloud while it gets "local hands" to operate on your computer (he discussed this on Latent Space). There are tricky problems — if Claude can only reach your files while your computer is online, it may be blocked until the machine is back, so some form of sync may be needed, with its own edge cases. Separately, he argued that working at a higher level of abstraction has always required understanding the lower l…
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 透露了架构方向：Claude 会越来越多地把"大脑"放在云端，再给它一双"本地的手"来操作你的电脑（他在 Latent Space 播客里也聊过）。他坦言这里有棘手的技术问题——如果 Claude 只能在你电脑在线时访问文件，电脑一关机它的工作就可能被卡住，所以也许需要某种同步机制，但同步本身有很多边界情况。另一条他强调：在更高抽象层工作，一直都需要理解更底层，coding agent 并不会改变这一点。

featured.title: Ep 94: Applied Compute CEO on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler & Why Post-Training Wins Inference
featured.summaryEn: RL is a hill-climbing machine — the hard part is defining the hill, so a company's evals and expert judgment are assets to safeguard. Post-training open models mostly pushes the cost-performance Pareto curve outward, and the largest inference workloads are exactly where to post-train first: post-training wins inference. The Applied Compute CEO, who previously worked at a frontier lab, framed "owning your intelligence" as flexibility and control rather than fear of malicious labs: where models run, how they're deployed, and what they're optimized for, which requires weights plus infrastructure for post-training, inference and routing. Models have been pulled from products more than once, especially in coding. He read the OpenAI–Base10 partnership as a clear multi-model signal: the conversation has shifted from the biggest model to the Pareto curve. The more out-of-distribution your data,…
featured.insightZh: RL 本质是一台"爬坡机器"，最难的是定义要爬的坡——企业的 eval 和专家判断是不该外泄的核心资产；后训练开源模型的真正价值多数在于把性价比的 Pareto 曲线外推，而规模最大的推理负载正是最该先做后训练的地方。 Applied Compute CEO（前大模型实验室研究员）认为，"拥有自己的智能"不是因为实验室会作恶，而是关乎灵活性与控制：在哪里运行、如何部署、针对成本/延迟/特定领域优化，这需要拿到权重、具备后训练、推理和路由的基础设施；同时模型在产品中被下架的情况（尤其在编码领域）已不止一次发生，实验室进入垂直领域后也未必继续服务竞争对手。他把 OpenAI 与 Base10 的合作（可用 OpenAI 承诺额度消费开源模型）视为多模型未来的明确信号：讨论焦点已从"最强最大的模型"转向 Pareto 曲线。 关于何时该后训练：数据越"分布外"（out of distribution），后训练越可能带来能力提升，但多数人后训练是为了优化性价比。企业真正的分布外数据是"判断轨迹"——不同风险阈值、运营模式和专长形成的决策方式。他建议先做 context/harness 优化，榨干后再优化 policy；一个客户用用户反馈做在线训练，提升了满意度和完成率、减少了工具调用失败。非可验证领域可以用基于 rubric 的 RL 作为代理，效果"出人意料地好"。阻碍持续学习的核心是从稀疏奖励中极高数据效率地训练，这仍未解决。 商业层面，他们专挑两类客户：数据高度分布外（制药、网络安全、芯片），或推理负载巨大。他的核心论点是"后训练赢得推理"——最大的负载最值得先后训练，训练方式还会影响推理部署（如长程工具调用 agent 与 decode 密集型负载的 prefill/decode 分离部署），并且让模型提高 10% token 效率与推理优化是同一枚硬币的两面。长期愿景是"新一代 AI 超大规模云"：倒金字塔底部是最难的训练，往上是推理、路由、上下文与 harness，再到安全、身份、agent 沙箱。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Claude shipped Google file co-editing: paste a Google file link or ask for a new doc, sheet or deck, and it opens beside the chat for you and Claude to edit together, with access following your Google sharing permissions — in beta on all paid plans. It also highlighted Every, which routes as much work as possible through agents and built a company-wide agent on Claude Managed Agents, used by everyone in Slack to share skills when new models land; after it caught on internally they released it to subscribers.
items.insightZh: Claude 官方发了两件事。一是 Google 文件协同：在 Claude 里粘贴 Google 文件链接，或让它新建文档/表格/幻灯片，文件会在聊天旁边打开，你和 Claude 可以一起编辑，访问权限沿用 Google 的共享权限，所有付费计划 beta 开放。二是客户案例：Every 团队尽可能让工作都走 agent，为了在新模型发布时让全员共享 skills，他们基于 Claude Managed Agents 搭了一个所有人都在 Slack 里用的公司级 agent，内部跑通后又开放给了订阅用户。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper said they couldn't have built the Every agent without Claude Managed Agents, and shared the full conversation about how it was built. He also pointed to a new featured app on the Slack marketplace — a concrete reference for "managed agent platform + Slack as the front door" in enterprise agent rollouts.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 直言：没有 Claude Managed Agents，他们做不出 Every 的 agent，并分享了与 Anthropic 关于搭建过程的完整对谈。他还提到 Slack 应用市场上有个很酷的新推荐应用。对于在做企业内部 agent 的团队，这是一个"托管 agent 平台 + Slack 作为入口"的现成参考。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argued cyber will be one of the most defining domains for AI and a top enterprise focus. AI creates a new level of security work — vibe-coded issues, agentic attacks, even accidental agent swarms hunting for data; OpenAI + Hugging Face is just a preview. Security teams are already the most resource-strapped, and agents become the solution too: expect a wave of agentic products protecting code, enterprise systems, critical infrastructure and data, and a booming market for professionals who can d…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 判断：网络安全将是未来几年 AI 最具决定性的领域之一，也是多数企业的重点。AI 会给安全团队带来全新量级的工作——vibe coding 引入的问题、agent 发起的攻击、甚至意外形成的"agent 群"四处搜刮数据；OpenAI + Hugging Face 只是预演。安全团队本就是企业里最缺资源的部门，压力只会更大，而 AI agent 同时也是解法：保护代码、企业系统、关键基础设施和数据的新一代 agent 产品会大量出现，能熟练部署安全 agent 的人才市场也会火爆。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said what's happening in AI-powered reverse engineering and decompilation is "absolutely insane" — soon all software will be de facto open source; AI is coming for everything. He also shared a full conversation. Read alongside Levie's point, security-through-obscurity for closed code is eroding.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 称 AI 驱动的逆向工程和反编译进展"绝对疯狂"，很快所有软件实际上都会变成开源——AI 正在冲击一切。他也附上了一段完整对谈。结合 Levie 的安全判断，这意味着闭源代码的"隐蔽性"作为防线正在失效。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch highlighted a "very simple feature" — thinking a bit less fast under a confidence threshold — which he expects to be extremely impactful for at-scale AI decision-making. He also joked that at this rate AI will get us GTA 7 before GTA 6.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 推荐了一个"很简单但会非常有影响"的功能：在置信度低于阈值时让模型"慢一点想"（化用《思考，快与慢》），他认为这对规模化的 AI 决策影响巨大。另一条调侃：照这个速度，AI 会让我们在 GTA 6 之前先玩上 GTA 7。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger hooked his team's claw up to X to trigger work faster: unassigned sessions are up for grabs, and the agent finds who last worked on the related code and pings them on the server. The whole thing was a single prompt, and the team server extended itself since plugins are now hot-reloadable.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 把团队的 claw 接到了 X 上以更快触发工作：未分配的 session 谁都可以领；agent 会查出谁最近改过相关代码，并在服务器上 ping 对应的人。整套东西只用了一个 prompt，而且由于插件现在支持热加载，团队服务器是"自己扩展了自己"。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 负责人
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux said they shipped four things deemed good to great plus some math proofs, but the community vote clearly demanded a reset — so the reset has been processed, and the improvements won't be unshipped. "See you tomorrow for Day 3." (The tweets don't specify what the reset covers.)
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 透露，他们发布了四项被评为"好到很好"的东西外加一些数学证明，但社区投票结果明确要求"reset"，于是 reset 已执行；而且已发布的改进不会撤回——"蛋糕可以兼得"，明天见 Day 3。（推文未说明 reset 的具体内容。）

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Google Labs and Gemini App VP Josh Woodward said mask-based editing was his favorite of the day's launches, with much more coming soon.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini App 负责人 Josh Woodward 表示，当天发布的功能里他最喜欢的是基于遮罩（mask）的编辑，并称"更多很快就来"。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex product lead Nan Yu (ex-Linear) worried this could cause extreme degradation in systems no one loves to maintain but someone has to.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 产品负责人 Nan Yu（前 Linear 产品负责人）提出担忧：AI 编码的普及可能会让那些"没人爱维护、但总得有人维护"的系统严重退化。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari criticized VCs chasing dopamine or rage-baiting on X: the platform isn't for nuance and you can't take things back, which erodes long-term brand and hurts the people "under" them most — he knows two people who lost deals that were all set because of X drama. Given how commoditized capital is, few are playing long-term games.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 批评太多 VC 在 X 上追逐多巴胺甚至故意引战博流量：X 不适合细腻表达，话说出去就收不回，这正在损害他们的长期品牌，而且伤害更多落在他们"下面"的人身上——他知道有两个人已经谈妥的交易因为 X 上的风波黄了。资本本身高度同质化、基金数量众多，真正打长期游戏的人很少。
